mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id AS cartId, c.user_id AS userId, c.product_id AS productId, c.quantity AS quantity, c.selected AS selected, p.name AS productName, p.price AS productPrice, p.cover_image AS productImage, p.unit AS productUnit FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
